name: 05 — Iteration cap stops a never-completing agent
description: Agent emits status='running' on every response and never sets a terminal status. The orchestrator must stop the loop once it has run maxIterations times, emit a single iteration_limit SSE event, write a finalReport summarizing the iteration count, and persist the session with status='completed' (the cap is treated as a clean stop, not an error). Pinning maxIterations=3 keeps wall-clock time under a second.
prompt: Keep working on this task forever, never finish.
